data.name: Settings.AddNoctisWindowsOpen
data.value: Add Noctis to Windows' Open-with list and Default apps for MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG, WAV and the other formats it plays. Windows then lets you pick it as the default.

data.name: Settings.ControlHowNoctisStarts
data.value: Control how Noctis starts and what the minimize and close buttons do.

data.name: Settings.ReopenLastTrackPlaybar
data.value: Reopen with your last track in the playbar, paused where you left off.

data.name: Settings.ControlHowLongText
data.value: Control how long text scrolls in the player bar, Up Next, and menus.

data.name: Settings.PinSidebarOpenAt
data.value: Pin the sidebar open at all times.

data.name: Settings.SlideSidebarOpenHover
data.value: Slide the sidebar open on hover.

data.name: Settings.ShowOneTilePer
data.value: Show one tile per release; other editions appear under "Other Versions" on the album page.

data.name: Settings.TurnFeatXTrack
data.value: Turn "(feat. X)" in track titles into artist credits.

data.name: Settings.WhichTagArtistsSection
data.value: Which tag the Artists section files a song under. Album Artist keeps compilations together and ignores per-track features.

data.name: Settings.FirstCreditedArtistEachTip
data.value: The first credited artist of each song's Artist tag

data.name: Settings.AlbumArtistTagSongsTip
data.value: The Album Artist tag; songs without one fall back to their artist

data.value: Text that splits one artist tag into several credited artists. Remove a separator to keep names like "Simon & Garfunkel" whole.

data.value: Add a separator, e.g. feat. or /

data.name: Settings.ClickCopyVersionSystemTip
data.value: Click to copy version and system info

data.name: Settings.OfferBetaBuildsUpdater
data.value: Offer beta builds in the updater. Off = stable releases only.

data.name: Settings.ShowVersionManagerDebug
data.value: Show the version manager and debug logs.

data.name: Settings.DownloadInstallAnyRelease
data.value: Download and install any release from GitHub. Installing closes the app.

data.name: Settings.SessionLogTroubleshootingShare
data.value: Session log for troubleshooting. Share these when reporting bugs.

data.name: Settings.OpenAppDataFolderTip
data.value: Open the app data folder (also holds crash.log)

data.value: Frost the window with translucent, blurred glass surfaces.

data.name: Settings.ShowAnimatedCoverArt
data.value: Show animated cover art when available.

data.name: Settings.TintEachAlbumS
data.value: Tint each album's page with the colour of its cover, like Apple Music. Off keeps the plain theme background.

data.name: Settings.HowCoverAppearsLyrics
data.value: How the cover appears on the Lyrics page. Discs spin while music plays.

data.name: Settings.AlbumCoverAsTip
data.value: The album cover as it is

data.name: Settings.SleeveRecordPeekingOutTip
data.value: A sleeve with the record peeking out

data.name: Settings.CassetteCoverItsLabelTip
data.value: A cassette with the cover on its label

data.value: How the Cover Flow page arranges the queue's covers.

data.name: Settings.ClassicRowPlayingCoverTip
data.value: The classic row: playing cover centred, history and up next to each side

data.name: Settings.TiltedCoversDiagonalPathTip
data.value: Tilted covers on a diagonal path with the track details beside them

data.name: Settings.MosaicQueueSCoversTip
data.value: A mosaic of the queue's covers

data.name: Settings.HowMiniPlayerLooks
data.value: How the mini player looks. Classic morphs with its size; Pill and Sleeve are fixed designs.

data.name: Settings.ResizableGlassCardIconTip
data.value: The resizable glass card: icon, bar, card, large icon and lyrics forms

data.name: Settings.RoundCoverOverlappingLightTip
data.value: A round cover overlapping a light card with the title and transport

data.name: Settings.SpinningDiscPeekingOutTip
data.value: A spinning disc peeking out of the top of a light card

data.name: Settings.AddExtraControlsPlayer
data.value: Add extra controls to the player island: skip a few seconds, change the playback speed, set a sleep timer, shuffle.

data.name: Settings.JumpFewSecondsEither
data.value: Jump a few seconds either way without leaving the track.

data.name: Settings.1ButtonOpensSpeed
data.value: A 1× button that opens a speed menu from 0.75× to 2×. Speed resets to normal on the next launch.

data.name: Settings.SleepTimerOneClick
data.value: The sleep timer one click away instead of inside the options menu.

data.name: Settings.ShuffleButtonAfterRepeat
data.value: A shuffle button after Repeat. Shuffle also stays in the queue panel.

data.name: Settings.HowWidePlayerIsland
data.value: How wide the player island at the bottom is. Wider gives the seek bar more room for precise scrubbing. You can also drag the island's rounded edges. Double-click the slider knob to go back to the default.

data.name: Settings.ShowHowFarAlong
data.value: Show how far along the current song is as a progress bar on the Noctis taskbar button. Turns amber while paused.

data.name: Settings.FiveCoversPerRow
data.value: Five covers per row. Turn off to pick your own cover size.

data.name: Settings.BlurredAlbumArtworkDrifts
data.value: The blurred album artwork drifts and pulses with the beat behind the lyrics on the lyrics page, the lyrics panel and the mini player. Artwork background only.

data.name: Settings.DrawLiveSpectrumMusic
data.value: Draw a live spectrum of the music along the bottom of the lyrics page. Follows the sound as it is heard; rests flat while paused.

data.name: Settings.TintBarsCurrentCover
data.value: Tint the bars with the current cover's colour, on the Visualizer page and the lyrics page. Off paints them white.

data.name: Settings.FrequencyBarsRisingFromTip
data.value: Frequency bars rising from the bottom

data.name: Settings.BarsMirroredAboutCentreTip
data.value: Bars mirrored about the centre line

data.name: Settings.LoopVideoGIFBehind
data.value: Loop a video or GIF behind the lyrics on the lyrics page instead of the blurred cover. Plays only while the lyrics page is open.

data.name: Settings.DimAllButCurrent
data.value: Dim all but the current line and its neighbors in fullscreen.

data.name: Settings.KeepWordsWholeWhen
data.value: Keep words whole when TTML lyrics split them into syllables.

data.name: Settings.HowSolidPlaybackBar
data.value: How solid the playback bar's background looks.

data.name: Settings.HowMuchDesktopShows
data.value: How much of your desktop shows through the mini player's glass.

data.name: Settings.SongsBlendSmoothlyInto
data.value: Songs blend smoothly into each other. Albums still play without transitions.

data.name: Settings.UnavailableWhileExclusiveMode
data.value: Unavailable while Exclusive Mode is on.

data.name: Settings.TransitionsTimedUsingEach
data.value: Transitions timed using each song's key and tempo.

data.name: Settings.SimpleFadeBetweenSongs
data.value: Simple fade between songs for a set duration.

data.name: Settings.KeepSongVolumeAt
data.value: Keep song volume at a consistent level.

data.name: Settings.TracksFlowIntoEach
data.value: Tracks flow into each other without a pause.

data.name: Settings.WhenQueueEndsKeep
data.value: When the queue ends, keep playing similar songs from your library.

data.name: Settings.AllowExplicitSongsWhen
data.value: Allow explicit songs. When off, they're skipped unless you play them directly.

data.name: Settings.BitPerfectOutputBypasses
data.value: Bit-perfect output that bypasses the Windows mixer. Other apps go silent and song transitions are off while it's active.

data.name: Settings.DetectBPMKeyAutoMix
data.value: Detect BPM and key for AutoMix and Track Radio.

data.name: Settings.WriteBPMKeyInto
data.value: Write BPM/key into the file's tags for newly analyzed tracks. This modifies your files.

data.name: Settings.ParametricEQTuneEach
data.value: Parametric EQ — tune each band's frequency, gain, and width (Q).

data.name: Settings.LevelBeforeEQLowerTip
data.value: Level before the EQ — lower it if boosted bands distort. Double-tap to reset.

data.name: Settings.CenterFrequencyHzTypeTip
data.value: Center frequency (Hz) — type, scroll, or use arrow keys

data.name: Settings.QBandWidthHigherTip
data.value: Q (band width) — higher values affect a narrower range around the frequency

data.name: Settings.UsedByAudioConverter
data.value: Used by the audio converter. Leave blank to auto-detect.

data.name: Settings.RightClickSongOpen
data.value: Right-click a song → open its audio file in this program, e.g. an editor or analyzer. Leave blank to choose a program each time (Windows).

data.name: Settings.AdjustVolumeUsingReplayGain
data.value: Adjust volume using ReplayGain tags. Scan tracks via right-click → Scan ReplayGain.

data.name: Settings.ControlPlaybackFromPhone
data.value: Control playback from your phone on your local network. Traffic is unencrypted, so avoid untrusted Wi-Fi.

data.name: Settings.IfPhoneBlocksLink
data.value: If your phone blocks the link as insecure, choose Continue. The remote uses plain HTTP on your local network.

data.name: Settings.CopyFullLinkIncludingTip
data.value: Copy the full link, including the access key

data.name: Settings.WaitingPhoneScanCode
data.value: Waiting for a phone. Scan the code or tap it to enlarge.

data.name: Settings.ShowCurrentSongDiscord
data.value: Show your current song on Discord.

data.name: Settings.AddAlbumNameUnder
data.value: Add the album name under the artist on your Discord card. Off keeps the card to title and artist.

data.name: Settings.StreamLibraryFromJellyfin
data.value: Stream your library from Jellyfin, Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic, or any other Subsonic-compatible server.

data.name: Settings.UseOnlineLyricsWhen
data.value: Use online lyrics when local lyrics are missing.

data.name: Settings.TagSourcesSearchMetadata
data.value: Tag sources for Search metadata, in order.

data.name: Settings.FoldersWhereMusicStored
data.value: Folders where your music is stored.

data.name: Settings.FindNewTracksUpdate
data.value: Find new tracks and update search.

data.name: Settings.RenameMoveFilesInto
data.value: Rename and move files into a tag-based folder structure, with a preview first.

data.name: Settings.FindDuplicateTracksRemove
data.value: Find duplicate tracks and remove the copies you don't want.

data.name: Settings.IdentifyPoorlyTaggedTracks
data.value: Identify poorly-tagged tracks and review proposed tags before applying.

data.value: Import an M3U, Exportify CSV or TuneMyMusic JSON export, or a Deezer playlist link, and match tracks to your library.

data.name: Settings.ScanMusicFoldersWhen
data.value: Scan music folders when Noctis starts.

data.name: Settings.UpdateLibraryAutomaticallyAs
data.value: Update the library automatically as files change.

data.value: Use artwork embedded in file tags for album covers.

data.name: Settings.HiddenFromShuffleRadio
data.value: Hidden from shuffle and radio until their snooze expires.

data.value: Removed from your library with their files kept on disk. Restore adds them back.

data.name: Settings.RestoreDefaultsClearSaved
data.value: Restore defaults and clear saved library data.

data.name: Settings.AreYouSureAction
data.value: Are you sure? This action cannot be undone.

data.value: Delete cached artwork. It will rebuild on the next scan.

data.name: Settings.NoteRemovesAllArtwork
data.value: Note: This removes all artwork from your library.

data.value: Click a key to change it. Press Esc while recording to cancel, Backspace to unbind. Media keys on your keyboard always work and are not listed here.

data.value: Play some tracks to see your top artists
